test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

I told Kavya that she was late for her class.

options.text: I said to Kavya, “Why are you late for your class?”
I said to Kavya, “She was late for her class.”
I said to Kavya, “You were late for your class.”
I said to Kavya, “You are late for your class.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **I said to Kavya, “You are late for your class.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech and we need to convert it to direct speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'told' changes to **'said to'** in the direct speech part.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is replaced with inverted commas ("...") to show the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letter.
 
• The be verb '**was**' in the indirect speech changes to '**are**' in the direct part.
 
• The pronoun 'she' changes to 'you' and '**her**' changes to '**your**' to form the direct speech. 
 
 

Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.

Hence, direct speech is - *I said to Kavya, “You are late for your class.”*
